primary_endpoint.contrast: joint_standby minus standby2014 on same accepted backend; newly reviewed backend if admitted before freeze, otherwise traceback-2

fallback.requires: A explicitly freezes fallback roster and acknowledges final-panel consumption before B collection

secondary_endpoints.status: exposed secondary; no pooled context metric or independent superiority claim
secondary_endpoints.uncertainty: undefined: one connected source sequence family per context

bootstrap.sampling: sample all original Cambray seed blocks with replacement, same draws for both models; include all members and repeated blocks; filter to finite measured common successes only after sampling; recompute average ranks with multiplicities each draw
bootstrap.quantiles: sorted usable draws at floor(.025*(n-1)) and ceil(.975*(n-1)); no interpolation
bootstrap.undefined: fewer than two pairs or either vector constant; null with reason, never zero; insufficient support/usable draws means no advancement

advancement.scope: one prespecified primary contrast; all others descriptive; point gain and interval use same measured common-success rows

controls.gc_content: fraction G/C in available supplied window [max(0,start-35),min(length,start+70)); higher GC has higher score; fixed direction and no fitted scale

subgroups.Cambray2018: descriptive only: coding sequence after start+3, GC <0.4, [0.4,0.6), >=0.6
subgroups.small_strata: retain coverage/counts, null subgroup contrast; no subgroup promotion gate or post-hoc strata

collection.schedule: Cambray then Kuo; input IDs sorted within study; model IDs sorted then cyclically rotated by input index, submitted in that deterministic record-major order
collection.timeout_policy: terminate process group, preserve timeout with null score; no retry
collection.total_cap_policy: stop scheduling, terminate running work at cap, preserve every remaining row as not_run; collection incomplete and no advancement
collection.outputs: exclusive new private directory 0700 and files 0600; immutable per-record receipts before aggregate results

independence.comparators: OSTIR1.1.3, frozen public2014 sequence-v1 and rebeca exp67_true only if admitted; rebeca Kuo-trained, not independent on Kuo; UTR degeneracy retained as undefined rank
